entries.final_answer: Application/reporting half only (generation stays in #3947): generator-shape proposals gain an optional structured payload validated by the existing ProposalPayload union, synthesize translates translatable ones into the typed Proposal it applies, names every untranslatable one, and emits a diagnostics block naming record shape, finding counts and zero planned; exit codes stay unchanged so the documented dry-run exit-0 contract holds.
entries.question: Scope confirmation for #6385: which half of the create->synthesize gap does this Mission deliver, and how does synthesize stop being a silent no-op without changing the documented exit-code contract?
entries.rationale: Batch-14 triage on #6385 splits generation (#3947) from application/reporting; the issue itself names a structured field as the safer direction than verb parsing, and its Minimum bar is that a created record with findings must not end in a silent successful-looking empty batch. Changing the documented exit code would be a contract change on a P2 fix.
